subject: FORMATTED-TIME function
notes: Was DIVERGES. FORMATTED-TIME now requires a TIME format; a DATE format is rejected with COBOL1631 where it previously fabricated a value. The golden covers the common-time shapes of 15.3.3.1/15.3.3.2 plus the UTC (15.3.3.5) and offset (15.3.3.6) forms, including the extended offset subformat pairing 15.3.3.6.1 requires.
